notes.title: Ultrawide Player Select, Alt+Enter Window Mode, Quick Settings Change
notes.content: [list][*][p]Player select screen fits on ultrawides: Drew wider player select screen art & all the options stay in view on ultrawides now at 2560x1080 and 3440x1440[/p][/*][*][p]Player feedback: Player select screen - LB button or space/right mouse can now cycle through time, lives and paint options quickly while holding the harpoon on them. LB or RB can cycle through paint options while roaming around but it's only mentioned in a tool tip[/p][/*][*][p]Player feedback: Alt+Enter or F11 will toggle windowed/fullscreen mode to make it easier to move a window to another monitor. If you have an ultrawide that you are bringing the window to, resetting players or finishing a round will correct the settings right now[/p][/*][*][p]Player select screen: Level sign bases light up when active[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I had a issue where an extension corrupted and was not allowing quick VM compiles in GameMaker anymore after the last update, but have figured it out. notes.title: 4K & Ultrawide Objective/Tutorial Fixes for August 14

[list]

notes.title: New Carpoon Demo!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5lDMs6Y5syA;full][/previewyoutube]

Carpoon has evolved a lot since its original demo! Try out the new demo with:

• Parkin’ Panic graphics refresh & geyser jumps
• Steam Deck & 1440p support
• Player position & colours save after each round
• New camera system
• Semi-secret cameo hat
• Lots of QoL improvements
• Trucklings that follow you

Thank you for your support! 
-Tom

notes.title: The Road to Carpoon’s First Tournament, Held at LTX 2023 + Recent Progress
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=08-7ix9-c5g;full][/previewyoutube]

Carpoon recently had its first tournament as a mystery game at LTX 2023. Thank you to my friends for the countless hours they helped test Carpoon, to LTX for the opportunity, and to all the tournament players!

Fixed before the tournament, there was a semi-rare hard crash while harpooning that turned out to be partially related to inheritance, and now things are easier for me to adjust. More on the tournament in the video.

Other notable updates:
• In simultaneous grapples, an A-button will appear and it’s a frantic race to out-mash the other player to break free. This fixes stalemates that were happening in VS when ropes couldn’t be cut

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38366190/19dab029b0bf683190bffd9718653c292b05aff7.gif[/img]

• Baby trucks on your team drive to you when you honk your horn with a right stick click. In this last truck standing mode, there are also now trophies for second and third place

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38366190/79f9a2b8ed0ee5362d145efa8bbdbcd7095e753f.gif[/img]

• Player trucks now recoil back off harpoon shots and rumble

Next up: Going over more feedback and smoothing out the camera

-Tom

notes.title: "Hang Four" Surfmobile Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JcPuzMDtpXs;full][/previewyoutube]

I finished adding Waves/Co-op mode to Carpoon's Volcarnage Island! Completely my silly idea of cars on surfboards wasn't as easy as I thought thanks to adding paths for them to follow. At this point, there are a couple of tweaks still needed for this level but I'll mostly be moving on to the Autoworks and perhaps one other thing.

Also, we had our first community matchmaking session recently over Steam Remote Play. Stay tuned for more to come in the future!
